about: Star data for odybench, written by tools/fetch_stars.py.  Every star's HIP number is taken from SIMBAD's identifier list for its Bayer designation and checked against the Hipparcos row (position and magnitude).  'adopted' is what odybench.ephem.star() uses.

conventions.positions: ICRS degrees; hip2 at epoch J1991.25 (JD 2448349.0625 TT); SIMBAD at J2000
conventions.proper_motion: mas/yr; pmra is mu_alpha* = mu_alpha cos(dec)
conventions.propagation: linear space motion with radial velocity (skyfield Star / ERFA eraPmsafe)

sources.hip2: van Leeuwen 2007, A&A 474, 653, Hipparcos new reduction, VizieR I/311/hip2
sources.hip1: ESA 1997, The Hipparcos and Tycho Catalogues, ESA SP-1200, VizieR I/239/hip_main

Hipparcos (van Leeuwen 2007, I/311/hip2; = ESA 1997 orbital solution): the astrometric parameters refer to the CENTRE OF MASS (I/239 hip_main AstroRef '+', MultFlag 'O', DMSA part O orbit P 18295.4 d, a0 2490.40 mas); i.e. an orbit-corrected barycentric proper motion
adopted.rv_source: Bond et al. 2017, ApJ 840:70, sect. 5.1: system (centre-of-mass) velocity -7.70 km/s from RVs 1903-1995 and the relative orbit, -8.47 km/s after removing Sirius A's gravitational redshift (the true radial component of the space motion)

proper_motion_comparison_m1177.method: ERFA eraPmsafe space motion from J1991.25 (catalogue coordinates, ICRS)

fk5_long_baseline_I149A.note: FK5 (Fricke et al. 1988) ground-based meridian proper motion, central epochs RA 32.58+1900, Dec 12.06+1900; -3.847 s/cy, -120.53"/cy converted with cos(dec); FK5 system, not rotated to ICRS (FK5-Hipparcos spin is about 1 mas/yr)

hipparcos_reduced_with_bond2017_orbit.note: the Hipparcos centre-of-mass proper motion re-referred from the fixed DMSA/O orbit to Bond et al. 2017's orbit: minus the least-squares slope of (Bond orbit - DMSA orbit) over the mission 1989.85-1993.21 (computed here; it assumes the 5-parameter fit absorbed that slope)

sirius_A_instantaneous_J1991.25.note: barycentric + orbital velocity of Sirius A at J1991.25 from Bond et al. 2017 Tables 4-5: what a short-baseline single-star (photocentre) solution would have measured

rv_simbad_sirius_A.note: same proper motion with SIMBAD's RV for Sirius A (-5.5 km/s, 2006AstL...32..759G) instead of the system's

rv_bond_observed.note: system velocity without the gravitational-redshift correction

aldebaran.role: grammar: Hyades (Aldebaran, the bright star of the V; not a cluster member)
